steps.js: (async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.addLocalRepository(__REPO_PATH__); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const before = await window.gitgoodBridge.invokeRaw('repo.signing.get', __REPO_PATH__); return JSON.stringify(before.value ? before.value.effective : before); })()

(async () => { await window.gitgoodBridge.invokeRaw('repo.signing.set', __REPO_PATH__, 'local', { format: 'ssh', key: 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIBogusPublicKeyDataHere test@example.com', signCommits: true, signTags: false }); const after = await window.gitgoodBridge.invokeRaw('repo.signing.get', __REPO_PATH__); return JSON.stringify(after.value ? after.value.local : after); })()

(async () => { window.__gitgood.actions.bumpSigningConfigVersion(); window.__gitgood.actions.setView('changes'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const titles = [...document.querySelectorAll('.commit-form svg title')].map((t) => t.textContent); return JSON.stringify({ hasSigningIndicator: titles.includes('Commits are signed') }); })()

(async () => { await window.gitgoodBridge.invokeRaw('repo.signing.set', __REPO_PATH__, 'local', { signCommits: false }); const after = await window.gitgoodBridge.invokeRaw('repo.signing.get', __REPO_PATH__); window.__gitgood.actions.bumpSigningConfigVersion(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const titles = [...document.querySelectorAll('.commit-form svg title')].map((t) => t.textContent); return JSON.stringify({ local: after.value ? after.value.local : after, hasSigningIndicator: titles.includes('Commits are signed') }); })()
